content: Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefi be bɑ Sorobɑbɛli Sɑlɑtiɛlin bii kɑ Yosue swĩimɑ bɑ kɑ nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, berɑ Serɑyɑ kɑ Yeremi kɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi
kɑ Amɑriɑ kɑ Mɑluku kɑ Hɑtusi
kɑ Sekɑniɑ kɑ Rehumu kɑ Mɛremɔtu
kɑ Ido kɑ Ginɛtoi kɑ Abiɑ
kɑ Miyɑmini kɑ Mɑɑdiɑ kɑ Biliɡɑ
kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Yoyɑribu kɑ Yedɑyɑ
kɑ Sɑlu kɑ Amɔku kɑ Hilikiyɑ kɑ Yedɑyɑ. Berɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ be bɑ bu somimɔn wiruɡibu Yosuen wɑɑti.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Lefibɑ, berɑ Yosue kɑ Binui kɑ Kɑdimiɛli kɑ Serebiɑ kɑ Yudɑ kɑ Mɑtɑniɑ. Mɑtɑniɑ wi, kɑ win tɔmbɑ bɑ rɑ siɑrɑbun womusu ko.
Bɑkibukiɑ kɑ Uniwɑ bɑ rɑ sɔmburu ko ben mɛro bisibu Lefi ben bɔkuɔ.
Yosuewɑ u Yoyɑkimu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yoyɑkimu u seewɑ u Eliɑsibu mɑrɑ. Mɑ Eliɑsibu u seewɑ u Yoyɑdɑ mɑrɑ.
Yoyɑdɑ u mɑɑ seewɑ u Yonɑtɑm mɑrɑ. Mɑ Yonɑtɑm u seewɑ u Yɑduɑ mɑrɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu Yoyɑkimun wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robu, berɑ Mɛrɑyɑ, Serɑyɑn bweseru sɔɔ kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ, Yeremin bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Mɛsulɑmu, Ɛsidɑrɑsin bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Yokɑnɑni, Amɑriɑn bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Yonɑtɑm, Mɛlukin bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Yosɛfu, Sebɑniɑn bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Adinɑ, Hɑrimun bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Hɛlikɑi, Mɛrɑyɔtun bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Sɑkɑri, Idon bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Mɛsulɑmu, Ginɛtonin bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Sikiri, Abiɑn bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Pilitɑi, Minyɑmini kɑ Mɔɑdiɑn bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Sɑmuɑ, Biliɡɑn bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Yonɑtɑm, Semɑyɑn bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Mɑtinɑi, Yoyɑribun bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Usi, Yedɑyɑn bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Kɑlɑi, Sɑlɑin bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Ebɛɛ, Amɔkun bweseru sɔɔ,
kɑ Hɑsɑbiɑ, Hilikiyɑn bweseru sɔɔ, kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli, Yedɑyɑn bweseru sɔɔ.
Tɔn bèn wɑɑti sɔɔ bɑ Lefi be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robu kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun yĩsɑ yoruɑ tireru sɔɔ n kɑ dɑ Dɑrusi Pɛɛsibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɑɑti sɔɔ, berɑ Eliɑsibu kɑ Yoyɑdɑ kɑ Yokɑnɑni kɑ Yɑduɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ Lefi be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robun yĩsɑ yoruɑ yerukobun ɡɑrin tireru sɔɔ sere Yokɑnɑni, Eliɑsibun biin wɑɑti sɔɔ tɔnɑ.
Lefibɑn yɛnu yɛ̃ro beni, Hɑsɑbiɑ kɑ Serebiɑ kɑ Yosue, Kɑdimiɛlin bii, berɑ bɑ rɑ womusu ko bu kɑ Gusunɔ siɑrɑ kpɑ Lefi be bɑ tie bɑ n wurɑmɔ nɡe mɛ Dɑfidi Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u ɡeruɑ.
Be bɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔn kɔ̃sobu, berɑ Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Bɑkibukiɑ kɑ Abudiɑsi kɑ Mɛsulɑmu kɑ Tɑlumɔɔ kɑ Akubu.
Be kpurowɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yoyɑkimu, Yosuen bii, Yosɑdɑkin debubun wɑɑti sɔɔ. Beyɑ bɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ Nɛɛmi wi u sɑ̃ɑ kpɑro kɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi wi u sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo kɑ tire yoron wɑɑti sɔɔ.
Bɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten
wii ɡoberun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di

Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten wii ɡoberun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru dimɔ, bɑ dɑ bɑ Lefibɑ mɛnnɑmɑ beri berikɑn di mi bɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ bu kɑ tɔ̃ɔ te di nuku dobu sɔɔ bɑ n womusu mɔ̀ bɑ n sɛkɛtirɛnu kɑ mɔrɔkunu kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔɡenu soomɔ.
Wom kowo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmun bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Nɛtofɑɔ kɑ Bɛti Giliɡɑliɔ kɑ Gebɑn bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kɑ Asimɑfɛtiɔ bɑ mɛnnɑmɑ dɔmɑ te, domi wom kowo be, bɑ tii yɛnusu kuɑwɑ Yerusɑlɛmun bɔkuɔ.
Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ bɑ tii dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ tɔmbu kɑ kɔnnɔsu kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru dɛɛrɑsiɑ.
Nɛ, Nɛɛmi, nɑ derɑ Yudɑbɑn wiruɡibu bɑ yɔɔwɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru wɔllɔ mɑ bɑ wom kowobu bɔnu kuɑ wuuru yiru. Bɔnu ɡbiikɑɑ yɑ sĩɑ yɑ dɑ nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Kubɑnu.
Mɑ Hosee kɑ Yudɑbɑn wiruɡibun bɔnu bɑ wom kowo be swĩi biruɔ.
Yen biruwɑ tɔn beni bɑ mɑɑ swĩi. Berɑ, Asɑriɑ kɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi kɑ Mɛsulɑmu
kɑ Yudɑ kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Yeremi
kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun bii be bɑ kɔbi nɛni kɑ Sɑkɑri, Yonɑtɑm bii, Semɑyɑn debubu, Mɑtɑniɑ kɑ Misee kɑ Sɑkuri kɑ Asɑfun sikɑdobu,
kɑ sere win tɔmbu Semɑyɑ kɑ Asɑrɛli kɑ Milɑlɑi kɑ Gilɑlɑi kɑ Mɑi kɑ Nɛtɑnɛɛli kɑ Yudɑ kɑ Hɑnɑni. Tɔn be, bɑ mɔrɔkunu nɛni ni Dɑfidi Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u kuɑ. Mɑ Ɛsidɑrɑsi tire yoro u bu swɑɑ ɡbiiye.
Ye bɑ tunumɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Bwiɑ, yerɑ bɑ dɑ Dɑfidin wuun yɔɔ yerɔ mɑ bɑ yɔɔwɑ ɡɑnɑ yen wɔllɔ bɑ kɑ Dɑfidin sinɑ kpɑɑru tuke, mɑ bɑ dɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Nim, sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
Wom kowobun bɔnu yiruse yɑ mɑɑ sĩɑ yɑ dɑ nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ. Mɑ nɛ kɑ tɔn be bɑ tie sɑ bu swĩi biruɔ. Mɑ sɑ dɑ kɑ wuu kɔ̃su yee te bɑ mɔ̀ Pɛ̃ɛn dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃ru yerun ɡɑ̃ɑrɔ sere kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te tɑ yɑsun berɑ ɡiɑ
kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑimuɔ kɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ sokumɔ Tɔkɔ sere kɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Swɛ̃ɛ kɑ wuu kɔ̃su yee te bɑ mɔ̀ Hɑnɑnɛɛlin bɔkuɔ kɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Mɛɑn bɔkuɔ sere kɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Yɑ̃ɑnu.
Mɑ wom kowo be kpuro bɑ dɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Mɑ nɛn tii nɑ yɔ̃rɑ mi kɑ siri kowo be bɑ mɑn swĩi
kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo beni, Eliɑkimu kɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Minyɑmini kɑ Misee kɑ Elionɑi kɑ Sɑkɑri kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ be bɑ kɔbi soomɔ kpuro
kɑ sere mɑɑ Mɑɑseyɑ kɑ Semɑyɑ kɑ Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ Usi kɑ Yokɑnɑni kɑ Mɑɑkiyɑ kɑ Elɑmu kɑ Esɛɛ. Mɑ wom kowobu bɑ womusu mɔ̀. Yisirɑyɑwɑ u bu kpɑre.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, tɔmbɑ yɑ̃ku dɑbi dɑbinu kuɑ mɑ bɑ nuku dobu kuɑ. Domi Gusunɔ u bu nuku doo bɑkɑbu wɛ̃. Kurɔbu kɑ bibun tii bɑ nuku dobu kuɑ mɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di nuku dobun kuuki yi nɔɔrɑ n tomɑ.
Ye n sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu
kɑ Lefibɑn bɔnu

Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bɑ tɔmbu ɡɔsɑ bu kɑ diɑ kɔ̃su mi bɑ rɑ kɛ̃nu kɑ dĩɑ ɡbiikinu yi kɑ sere tiɑ tiɑ ye bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃ ben mɔrun wɔkuru bɑɑteren wɔllɔ. Mɑ bɑ tɔn be yiire bu dĩɑ ni mwɛɛri wusun di ni bɑ koo yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ. Yudɑbɑ bɑ nuku dobu mɔ yèn sɔ̃ yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ bɑ wurɑ ben sɔmburu sɔɔ,
bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ bɑ tɔmbu dɛɛrɑsiɑmɔ. Mɛyɑ wom kowobu kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ mɑɑ woodɑ ye kpuro mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ nɡe mɛ Dɑfidi kɑ win bii Sɑlomɔɔ bɑ ɡeruɑ.
Domi yellu Dɑfidi kɑ Asɑfun wɑɑti wom kowobɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ be bɑ rɑ siɑrɑbun womusu ko Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃.
Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Nɛɛmin wɑɑti sɔɔ, Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ rɑ wom kowobu kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔn kɔ̃sobu kɑ Lefibɑ ben dĩɑnu wɛ̃wɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere. Kpɑ Lefi be, bu mɑɑ Aronin bibun bweseru wɛ̃ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ beɡiɑ.
Nɛɛmi u ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu kɔsɑ
